title: Verify SQL connectivity after unplanned restart by RDP to fortna-wcs-primary and connecting via SSMS
summary: After an unplanned restart, RDP into the primary server (fortna-wcs-primary.txrth.otnet.ups.com) and use SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS) to confirm you can connect to the SQL instance. A successful SSMS connection is the observable evidence that the restarted SQL services are up and running.
when_to_use: Use when an unplanned restart has occurred and you need to verify that the primary server is reachable and that SQL connectivity works from the current support/session.
roles_and_responsibilities: L2_support: Execute the RDP-to-primary and SSMS connectivity verification to confirm SQL connectivity succeeds after the unplanned restart.

access_required: Ability to launch and use SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS) in the RDP session
system_preconditions: An unplanned restart has already been performed (context for this connectivity check).

visual_references.description: Frame showing the instruction to RDP into fortna-wcs-primary.txrth.otnet.ups.com and open SSMS to check that you can connect.
Frame reinforcing the SSMS connectivity check (“Just make sure it’s good.”).

steps.title: RDP into the primary server fortna-wcs-primary.txrth.otnet.ups.com
steps.purpose: Establish a session on the primary server so you can perform the SQL connectivity verification described in the source.
steps.instruction: From your support session, RDP into the primary server named in the source: fortna-wcs-primary.txrth.otnet.ups.com.
steps.expected_result: You have an active RDP session to fortna-wcs-primary.txrth.otnet.ups.com.
steps.healthy_condition: The RDP session opens successfully and you are operating inside the primary server environment.
steps.failure_condition: You cannot establish the RDP session to fortna-wcs-primary.txrth.otnet.ups.com.
stop_or_escalate_if: If you cannot reach the primary via RDP, stop and escalate for deeper troubleshooting (the source only specifies the connectivity check after RDP).

steps.title: Open SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS) and attempt to connect
steps.purpose: Verify SQL connectivity from the primary server session using SSMS, as instructed by the source.
steps.instruction: In the RDP session, open SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS) and attempt to connect to the SQL instance on the primary server. The source’s check is to confirm that you can connect.
steps.expected_result: SSMS connection attempt succeeds (you can connect).
steps.healthy_condition: SSMS shows a successful connection to the SQL instance on the primary server (i.e., the connectivity check passes).
steps.failure_condition: SSMS cannot connect to the SQL instance on the primary server.
stop_or_escalate_if: If SSMS cannot connect to the primary SQL endpoint, stop and escalate for deeper troubleshooting (the source only specifies the connectivity check).

steps.title: Confirm restarted SQL services are up and running (via successful SSMS connectivity)
steps.purpose: Align the observable SSMS connectivity result with the source-stated expectation that the restarted services/sequels are up and running.
steps.instruction: After the SSMS connectivity check, confirm the source-stated expectation by using the successful SSMS connection as the observable evidence that the SQL services/sequels are up and running.
steps.expected_result: SSMS connectivity is successful, consistent with the source instruction to ensure the sequels are up and running.
steps.healthy_condition: SSMS remains connected (connectivity check passes) after the unplanned restart context.
steps.failure_condition: SSMS connectivity fails, indicating the restarted SQL services/sequels are not reachable from this session.

actions.label: Validate connectivity outcome
actions.exact_action: Use the successful SSMS connection as the evidence that the sequels are up and running.

stop_or_escalate_if: If SSMS connectivity does not succeed, stop and escalate for deeper troubleshooting (the source only specifies the connectivity check).

success_criteria: SSMS can connect to the SQL instance on the primary server after the unplanned restart.
healthy_conditions: SSMS connectivity check passes (successful connection) to the primary SQL endpoint.
failure_conditions: SSMS cannot connect to the primary SQL endpoint after the unplanned restart.
escalation_guidance: If SSMS cannot connect to the primary SQL endpoint, stop and escalate for deeper troubleshooting (the source only specifies the connectivity check).
